issues.description: transform callback silently ignored when delimiter splits a single string
issues.detail: The split happens before the existing transform branch runs over items, but items is now a freshly split list of str. If a caller passes both transform and delimiter, the transform applies fine, but the type overload for the str-only variant returns list[str] regardless. Fine. The real bug: when auto_parse_qs_csv already split the value into a list, delimiter is silently a no-op with no warning. Test even codifies this. Document it loudly or raise.

issues.description: ValueError on unsupported delimiter is the wrong exception shape
issues.detail: Every other validation failure in get_param_as_list path raises HTTPBadRequest or is caught and converted. A programmer passing delimiter=';' gets a raw ValueError that escapes to a 500. This is a programmer error, not request error, so ValueError is defensible, but then it should fire at param-parse time independent of whether the param is present. Currently if name not in params, the bad delimiter is silently accepted. Validate up front or document this asymmetry.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates symbolic constants and literal chars in one dict
issues.detail: Five keys, three of which map to themselves. The string 'pipeDelimited' and the character '|' are different kinds of thing and the dict pretends they aren't. Two small frozensets plus a tiny resolver would read cleaner and make the error message honest about which set the caller violated. Minor, but this is the kind of clever-flat-dict that costs the next reader a lookup.

issues.description: delimiter default in overloads is `None` literal instead of `...`
issues.detail: Every other keyword in the overload signatures uses `= ...` per typing convention; the new delimiter parameter uses `= None`. Functionally identical, stylistically inconsistent with the surrounding six overloads in the same function. Match the existing voice of the file.

issues.description: no test for delimiter combined with transform callback
issues.detail: Tests cover comma, space, pipe, unsupported, csv-interaction, and multi-value. No test exercises delimiter together with the transform argument, which is the next-most-likely real use (split then int-cast). Add one line of coverage; this is the interaction that will quietly break in six months.

review.summary: Small, scoped patch that does one thing: adds a delimiter kwarg to get_param_as_list. The diff is readable, matches surrounding style, ships docs and a news fragment, and has reasonable test coverage. NEEDS-WORK on two real items: ValueError on bad delimiter only fires when the param is present (inconsistent), and the silent no-op when auto_parse_qs_csv has already pre-split needs to be louder. The _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS dict mixing constants and literal chars is mild bad taste but not a blocker. Land after the two P1s are addressed.
